chapter: After the Army: JATP, clubs and first Europe trips
title: Touring France and Morocco with Mezzrow
summary: Mezzrow ordered regional food for the band, and Yannick Bruynoghe was road manager on tours of France and Morocco.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: When I was with Mezzrow we played all over France and all over the small countries and I was happy that Mezzrow was there because he knew the exact favorite food of whatever district we were in, you know. Like one district over there is, their specialty is coq au vin. The cock with the....

Le vin, yes, yes. And then there was, everywhere we went he would order the food for us because he knew what he thought we were going to like, which We did most of the time.
And we played all over France.
How long, when did go to France to live?
Oh, I'd say about, was about 50.
Yes, he had had a good bit of experience, yes.
He went there after writing the book, 'Really the Blues'.
Yes, and of course he went under the auspices of Hugues Panassié, too.
Yes, and he stayed. So we played in France and we went to Casablanca and Yannick.....
I'd better spell this for the.... YANNICK BRUINOGHE. This is the Belgian critic.
Yes, he was our road manager then.
He hadn't even got married yet to Margo. So they were planning all our trips and we went, as I said, all over France and we went to Morocco. We had a nice time in Morocco.
About ten days. Yes, about ten days. And this was all new to my wife and Morocco was new to me too. But I didn't go anywhere else until when I went to, over there for George
